crossRefs.note: The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the…
and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died; at the time the fire…
Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.
As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!
Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

people.name: Assir
people.line: Levite ancestor of the prophet Samuel

people.name: Ebiasaph
people.line: Levite descendant of Korah, ancestor of temple gatekeepers

people.name: Korah
people.line: Levite rebel leader; his descendants became temple servants

people.name: Tahath
people.line: Levite of the Kohathite clan, son of Assir
